standard_prerequisites.name: If L tensor_K L -> L is flat then for every intermediate field K subset L' subset L the map L' tensor_K L' -> L' is flat
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows passing to finitely generated subextensions.

standard_prerequisites.name: A finitely generated field extension which is formally unramified is finite separable

core_obligations: By the go-down lemma, flatness of the multiplication map descends to every intermediate field L', so it suffices to treat a finitely generated field extension L/K (proof lines 30494-30496). For such an extension the formally-unramified lemma gives that L/K is formally unramified, and the algebra lemma characterizing separable algebraic field extensions upgrades formal unramifiedness of a finitely generated field extension to finiteness and separability (proof lines 30497-30500).
proof_roadmap: Descend flatness to intermediate fields and reduce to the finitely generated case (proof lines 30494-30496).
Conclude finite separability from formal unramifiedness (proof lines 30497-30500).
